hypothesis: Joint supervised fine-tuning of a compact Q model and temporary Q reconstruction-map corrections may alter optimization and recovered accuracy at an unchanged deployed compact architecture.
initialization: Both cases load the identical direct-Q CIFAR BN seed2026 f=.5 compact-before checkpoint (19098 reals). Effective last Q kernel is B + sum_v delta_a[k,v] * C[o,v,offset], with delta_a initialized to ZERO. This trains corrections to a map contribution already absorbed into B, rather than decay-regularizing the old absolute ridge coefficients. Frozen C is taken from the direct-pilot pre-site4 consumer (site3 checkpoint), with removed INPUT indices from frozen site4 victims and retained OUTPUT indices from frozen site5 victims. No C is trained. No new channels/masks, labels in initialization or reconstruction fit are selected.
scope: One discovery source and ONE late Q consumer only. Two NEW three-epoch supervised CE repairs; all ordinary compact parameters and BN behave as in the existing recipe. frozen_maps keeps delta_a as a zero buffer; learned_maps makes its 1024 real components trainable. Same initialization, order/augmentation stream, schedule and labeled train data. No distillation/calibration stage, alpha or learning-rate search, new baseline training, new test evaluation or automatic extension. Joint training has 20122 trainable reals versus 19098 in control and 9216 frozen C coefficients plus a 64-real product-basis buffer; deploy both exactly to standard 6-Q-convolution/19098-real architecture. Temporary map storage is 1024 reals even in the frozen buffer control. Same attempted schedules; count successful AMP steps. Additional variables are NOT additional inference capacity. AdamW on centered corrections is a specified optimization choice, not equivalence to plain-SGD preconditioning. Report failures/negative outcomes.
resume: No scientific training on prepare. Explicit --run required after the user returns. Atomic epoch-boundary model/optimizer/scaler/RNG checkpoints; interrupted or stopped partial epoch restarts from its beginning. STOP file under the output folder is checked after batches; remove it when explicitly resuming. Final epoch only, no best validation selection.
priority_status: Exact post-Q-pruning Hamilton-map fine-tuning predecessor not located in targeted review; firstness NOT confirmed. Learned compensators and structural/gradient reparameterization are established broadly. This pilot is an optimization hypothesis, not a novelty claim.
